title: TWN2N: Time-Window Noise2Noise
description:
Python library for the self-supervised blind denoising of multichannel signals measured in dynamical systems, such as vibration and impact signals. The user provides the noisy signals and chooses the window size and the bottleneck size; the library builds the network, trains it on those same signals, and returns the denoised signals. No clean reference signal and no description of the noise are required.

The repository also contains the noise models (white, pink, and brown noise, and quantization), the signal-to-noise ratio metrics, the classical filters used as baselines, the two numerical benchmarks, and the scripts of the case studies of the paper Time-Window Noise2Noise: Self-Supervised Blind Denoising of Mechanical Vibration and Impact Signals (arXiv:2608.24443).
